title: cvg coherence check verifies the HTTP route registry is in sync with the docs
task_body: Add a coherence verifier that diffs the daemon's actually-mounted routes against what the AGENTS.md surface lists. New cvg coherence sub-subcommands parse the router source and compare. CI surfaces drift as a warning.
rationale: The route registry verifier lives in convergio-coherence (routes_parse/routes_diff + coherence entry point); cvg coherence wires it in; main.rs registers; CI runs the new check.
